title: White horse hills 5,300 m from the Avebury complex

tellings.quote: distance between the white horse hills of Wiltshire and there's several of them in the vicinity of the aberry stone circle complex is 5,300 m which is exactly 3.3 miles.

plain: The white horse hills of Wiltshire in England, hillsides with large horse figures on them, lie 5,300 metres from the Avebury stone circle complex, an ancient ring of standing stones, and a pyramid researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says this is exactly 3.3 miles. Drumm gives the measurement himself, without naming a source, as a sign that these ancient sites were laid out on purpose with precise distances.
